subject: MAP: Crestline POC environment - API keys & peering
messages:
From: Emma Li <emma.li@crestlinehealth.com>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-06-17T09:12:00Z
Subject: MAP kickoff + POC env details we need

Hi Karthik & Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the team was impressed with the latency numbers. We want to lock the MAP so we can begin a two-week POC next month. Before we kick off, our infra lead asked for a concise list of environment items Redwood needs from us to spin up the evaluation instance:

- API token provisioning: how many tokens, scopes required, rotation cadence recommendations
- Org setup: tenant model, service accounts, role assignments for our SREs
- IP allowlist: egress IPs or ranges we should add to our firewall
- VPC peering: rough steps and a contact at Redwood to coordinate peering test

Can you map these into the MAP with owners and target dates? We need this to short-circuit procurement and our security review. I attached our initial intake doc.

Thanks,
Emma
Emma Li
Director of Engineering, Crestline Health
crestlinehealth.com
Attachment: crestline_intake_v3.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Emma Li <emma.li@crestlinehealth.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-06-17T11:05:00Z
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff + POC env details we need

Emma — thanks for the clear list. I put together an initial MAP action grid below and attached a working XLSX that you can iterate on. High-level commitments we propose: 2-week POC (business days), single test tenant, one service account and scoped API token for CI, and a brief VPC peering test window.

MAP action grid (owner -> deliverable -> target):
- Crestline IT -> Provide CIDR(s) for allowlist and peering VLANs -> 2028-06-20
- Redwood (Karthik) -> Generate scoped API token + rotation guideline doc -> 2028-06-21
- Crestline SRE -> Create service account and SAML mapping -> 2028-06-22
- Redwood (Marissa) -> Provision test tenant and seed sample dataset -> 2028-06-24
- Redwood (Ben) -> Conduct VPC peering test (handshake + smoke) -> 2028-06-27

Notes and assumptions:
- API token: we'll issue a scoped token limited to the evaluation tenant and recommend rotating after the POC; if you prefer per-user tokens we can support that but it will add 1-2 days to setup.
- VPC peering: we support AWS peering and a liaison will coordinate route table checks; we'll provide a step-by-step checklist.
- IP allowlist: we can give a small set of stable egress IPs for the hosted test environment; if you need private peering only, we can prioritize that path.

I attached the MAP workbook (crestline_map_v1.xlsx) and a terse allowlist template to speed the firewall ticket. Marissa will follow up on scheduling the peering window.

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
Attachment: crestline_map_v1.xlsx
Attachment: allowlist_template.txt

From: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Emma Li <emma.li@crestlinehealth.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, soojin_lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-06-18T08:30:00Z
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff + POC env details we need

Emma — quick scheduling note. We propose the following cadence for the MAP close and POC:

- 2028-06-20: Crestline to share CIDRs and SRE contact (Crestline IT)
- 2028-06-21: Redwood to hand off API token and rotation guidance
- 2028-06-22: Org/service account mapping complete; SRE test login
- 2028-06-24: Tenant seeded and smoke tests executed by Redwood
- 2028-06-27: VPC peering smoke and end-to-end test with sample traffic
- 2028-07-01: POC close review & decision meeting (15–30 minutes)

Ben, can you take point on the peering checklist and coordinate a 2-hr window the week of 6/27?

Soojin — looping you on the security checklist we discussed; can you add the brief SOC notes for the MAP workbook?

Thanks —Marissa
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
Attachment: vpc-peering-instructions.pdf

From: ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Emma Li <emma.li@crestlinehealth.com>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-06-20T16:30:00Z
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff + POC env details we need

Emma — I'll run the peering coordination. Proposed test steps below; attaching the peering doc for your network team.

Peering test steps (high level):
1) Exchange VPC IDs and preferred CIDR ranges (Crestline to provide) — due 6/20
2) Redwood creates peering request and shares request ID and route targets — by 6/21
3) Crestline accepts request and updates route table to point at Redwood peer — by 6/22
4) Smoke test (ICMP/TCP) inside agreed test subnet; verify egress paths and ACLs — 6/27 window
5) If smoke passes, run sample inference traffic and confirm token-auth flows — 6/27

If your team prefers, we can run step 4 within a shorter maintenance window (60–90 minutes). I noted a couple of commonly seen checklist items in the doc (NAT gateway routing, security group loosening for the test subnets).

I'll kick off the ticket with your SRE (cc'd Emma) and propose 6/27 14:00–16:00 ET.

Cheers,
Ben Carter
Technical Program Manager, Redwood Inference
Attachment: peering_checklist_v1.pdf
